name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN took Bulambika 8 Nov; army counter-attacks
summary: FRN fighters took Bulambika and Bunyakiri in South Kivu on 6–8 Nov; the army counter-attacks; no major city has fallen
state: The FRN, the Kabila-led successor to AFC-M23, pushed through Kahuzi-Biega park and along the RN3 from 6 Nov, taking Bitale, Kalonge, Bulambika and Bunyakiri; the army announced a counteroffensive on 9 Nov and fighting continued around Kambegeti and Katasomwa on 10 Nov (Critical Threats, 11 Nov). The offensive has displaced about 160,000 people, according to Le Pays (via AllAfrica, 10 Nov). No capture of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira and no direct interstate fighting was found as of 16 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in South and North Kivu face displacement and disrupted aid. Travellers should follow FCDO advice, which warns against all travel to North and South Kivu. Fighting near mining areas can disrupt supplies of tin, tantalum and gold.
rubric_hit: Active fighting (Watch); no major city captured and no direct interstate fighting (Alert line not met)
